rawContent: Many of the men I spoke to said they were already suicidal before the allegation of sexual misconduct or any associated fallout (e.g., loss of a job in a high profile #MeToo case).
A big takeaway from the whole BethAnn thing should be that none of us own a #MeToo movement. To act like you do is to harm other survivors--and that disqualifies you from a leadership position.

@HJHaldanePhD Oof. This dynamic has been so intense since #MeToo. Way too many people thinking they're the first person to do the work and ignoring everyone who came before them. (And it's worth noting that many of them are producing bad work as a result.)
@most_articulate @polumechanos I feel you! I thought the #MeToo movement and the changes to Title IX policy might keep this stuff feeling more politicized, but apparently not.
